value.rationale: The result changes the equilibrium census at the source’s own calibration from eight to eleven and identifies the omitted states’ unstable dimensions. Two missed face saddles have codimension-one local stable manifolds, so the correction is directly relevant to local threshold geometry in the paper’s bistable resilience interpretation. The general fully mixed index-two theorem adds a reusable structural statement.
risks: No claim is made that the omitted saddles alone determine all global separatrices or policy conclusions.
